interpretation.stdev: Sample standard deviation of three measured repetitions; warmups excluded.
interpretation.phase_calibration: Raw engine phase rates multiplied by the whole-request monotonic/raw ratio. Calibrated phase seconds divide raw phase seconds by that ratio. Both are approximations; they are not exact per-phase host wall timing.
interpretation.wall_time: Actual client request wall_seconds is measured independently of phase calibration.
interpretation.percent_changes: Positive means a larger metric; higher rates and lower durations are favorable. Bracket mean gives equal weight to before/after window means.
interpretation.quality_limit: Equal frozen greedy output hashes do not establish exact recurrent-state parity or universal model quality. No adoption or statistical significance claim is made.
interpretation.hardware_scope: Host RAM/commit observations are not VRAM peak measurements.

decision.reason: Candidate does not beat the stock-after complete request walls; apparent phase changes do not establish a stable net serving gain.
